ambiguous_identity_matches.instructions: The caller has already retrieved a record and marked identity ambiguous. Comparing only the supplied bibliographic entry, retrieved structured metadata, and hash-verified excerpts, are they the same intellectual work? Do not guess whether a source exists and do not treat a live identifier alone as a match.

criteria.true: The supplied authorship, title, date, and identifier evidence coherently indicate the same work.
criteria.false: The supplied evidence does not establish that these are the same work.

version_relationship_coherent.instructions: If the entry and retrieved record appear to be different versions, does the supplied metadata establish a coherent preprint, working-paper, accepted-manuscript, or published-version relationship? A differing DOI alone is not evidence of a different work.

criteria.true: The supplied evidence supports a coherent version relationship or no version difference is material.
criteria.false: The version relationship is incompatible or is not established by the supplied evidence.
